build-type.name: Core Windows x86_64 - Publish monthly release (signing dry run)
build-type.description: Dry run of a signed monthly release: picks the build the monthly job would release, without pinning or tagging it or publishing metadata, and rebuilds that commit's NoNetRuntime installer signed with the KeyLocker certificate. A build of a PR branch rebuilds its own commit instead, to test the branch's changes. Each run uses 6 KeyLocker signatures: 4 executables, the uninstaller and the Setup.exe.

param.name: release.latest
param.spec: checkbox checkedValue='--latest' uncheckedValue='' label='Use the latest build' description='Rebuild the newest successful build, as a daily release would; uncheck for the build a month release would use (fails if that month is already released)' display='normal'

param.name: release.month
param.spec: text label='Release month' description='YYYY-MM whose last build to rebuild, with the latest build unchecked; leave empty for the previous month' validationMode='any' display='normal'

param.name: sign.cert.file
param.spec: text label='Signing certificate' description='Path on the agent to the public certificate (.crt) of the KeyLocker key' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: sign.key.alias
param.spec: text label='KeyLocker key alias' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

parameters.param: REM A branch build (a PR) rebuilds its own commit, already checked out: the commits the dry run REM picks are on master, so they cannot test the branch's changes to the release build. REM No labels: cmd cannot find a label in a script with LF line endings. set DEFAULT_BRANCH=%teamcity.build.branch.is_default% if not "%%DEFAULT_BRANCH%%"=="true" echo Not the default branch: rebuilding this build's own commit instead of the dry run's pick if "%%DEFAULT_BRANCH%%"=="true" if not exist release_commit.txt ( echo ##teamcity[buildProblem description='The dry run picked no build to release, so there is nothing to rebuild'] exit /b 1 ) if "%%DEFAULT_BRANCH%%"=="true" set /p RELEASE_COMMIT=<release_commit.txt REM The VCS root clones at depth 1, so the commit is fetched by SHA, as the monthly seed builds did if "%%DEFAULT_BRANCH%%"=="true" git fetch --depth=1 --no-tags origin %%RELEASE_COMMIT%% || exit /b 1 if "%%DEFAULT_BRANCH%%"=="true" git checkout --force --detach FETCH_HEAD || exit /b 1 if "%%DEFAULT_BRANCH%%"=="true" git submodule update --init --recursive --force --depth 1 || exit /b 1 git log -1 --format="Building %%%%H (%%%%ci)" REM The commit's own build.ps1 builds its installers, and commits before installer signing cannot sign findstr /c:"SignKeyAlias" scripts\installer\build.ps1 >nul || ( echo ##teamcity[buildProblem description='The commit to rebuild predates installer signing, so its installers cannot be rebuilt signed'] exit /b 1 ) REM This checkout persists between runs, and build.ps1 keeps earlier versions' installers beside new ones if exist scripts\installer\build del /q scripts\installer\build\ProteoWizard-*.exe scripts\installer\build\installer-version.txt 2>nul exit /b 0
